A_equal_items_exact_multiple.note: Perfect by construction when N is a multiple of D. Nothing can beat it.

B_variable_durations.note: Round-robin and golden-angle comparable. Golden-angle better in 1 of 8 configurations tested (D=12, N=4096, ~9%). Not a transferable advantage.

boundary: The packing advantage of the golden angle is real in continuous expanding spaces (phyllotaxis). It does not appear in a simple modular assignment of equal-sized items to a fixed device count, because that assignment is already exact and the golden angle has nothing to repair. A packing advantage requires a growing device count, non-uniform item sizes, or a spatial embedding.

coprimality_guard.note: Parity is a special case of coprimality. Any scheduler using the golden stride must assert gcd(stride, D) == 1.
